description: This file defines the MessageForm class, a Drupal form controller for handling contact message forms, including form building, validation, preview, and submission logic.

classes.name: MessageForm
classes.description: A Drupal form controller class for managing contact message forms, including form display, validation, preview, and submission handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method initializing dependencies such as entity repository, flood control, language manager, mail handler, date formatter, entity type bundle info, and time services.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form class with dependencies retrieved from the container.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Builds the contact message form, including fields for name, email, recipient, and copy options, with special handling for authenticated users and personal messages.

methods.name: actions
methods.description: Defines form actions, including submit and preview buttons, with access control for the preview.

methods.name: preview
methods.description: Handles the preview action by setting a preview flag and rebuilding the form.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates the form, including flood control checks to prevent spam.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the message entity, sends email notifications, registers flood control, and redirects after submission.
